quickAnswers.question: How do I update my Disney+ payment method?
quickAnswers.answer: Sign in on disneyplus.com, open Account, then Payment method to add or replace your card.

quickAnswers.question: What are the Disney+ plans and prices?
quickAnswers.answer: Disney+ offers monthly and annual plans with Standard and Premium options that vary by country.

learning.title: Disney+ plans and prices
learning.subtitle: Compare Standard, Premium, and annual options in your region.
learning.summary: Disney+ plan availability and pricing depend on your country. Review current options under Account before you change plans.
learning.content:
Disney+ plans and prices

Disney+ offers multiple plans so you can pick the right mix of price, ads, and video quality.

What to do first
Open disneyplus.com, sign in, and review Plans under Account.

When to escalate
If a third party bills you (carrier, Amazon, Apple), manage the plan with that provider.

learning.title: Watch Disney+ on your TV
learning.subtitle: Set up Disney+ on smart TVs, streaming sticks, and game consoles.
learning.summary: Install Disney+ from your device store, sign in, and choose a profile to start watching.
learning.content:
Watch Disney+ on your TV

Most modern smart TVs and streaming devices support Disney+.

What to do first
Open your device’s app store, search Disney+, install, then sign in.

When to escalate
If the app is missing from the store, check the Disney+ device list for alternatives.

learning.title: Login issues
learning.subtitle: Reset passwords, clear app data, and recover locked accounts.
learning.summary: Most login problems are fixed by resetting your password or signing out of other devices.
learning.content:
Login issues

If you can’t sign in, confirm the email on the account and try a password reset.

What to do first
Use Forgot password on the sign-in screen, then retry on disneyplus.com.

When to escalate
Contact support if reset emails never arrive or the account shows as locked.

learning.title: Device list
learning.subtitle: See which TVs, phones, and consoles work with Disney+.
learning.summary: Disney+ supports a wide range of TVs, mobiles, consoles, and streaming sticks. Check the official device list for your model.
learning.content:
Device list

Compatibility varies by manufacturer and OS version.

What to do first
Search your device model on the Disney+ Help Center device list.

When to escalate
If your device is listed but the app fails to install, note the error code for support.

learning.title: How do I update my Disney+ payment method?
learning.subtitle: Add or replace the card on your Disney+ account.
learning.summary: Update payment details from Account → Payment method while signed in on the web.
learning.content:
How do I update my Disney+ payment method?

You can change the card Disney+ bills when your subscription renews.

What to do first
Sign in at disneyplus.com → Account → Payment method → Update.

When to escalate
If Disney+ is billed by Apple, Google, Amazon, or a carrier, update payment with that store instead.

learning.title: Disney+ subscriptions through a third party
learning.subtitle: Manage plans sold by Apple, Amazon, carriers, and more.
learning.summary: Third-party subscriptions are managed with the seller, not always inside Disney+ Account settings.
learning.content:
Disney+ subscriptions through a third party

If you subscribed via a store or carrier, billing changes happen there.

What to do first
Check your original purchase receipt to see who bills you.

When to escalate
Open Get in touch if you can’t tell whether Disney+ or a partner owns the subscription.

learning.title: Getting started with Disney+
learning.subtitle: Create an account, pick a plan, and start streaming.
learning.summary: New subscribers create an account, choose a plan, then set up profiles for each viewer.
learning.content:
Getting started with Disney+

Sign up on disneyplus.com or in the app, choose a plan, and create profiles.

What to do first
Finish payment setup, then add a profile with the right maturity rating.

When to escalate
Use live chat if checkout fails after multiple payment attempts.

learning.title: Bundle plans and Hulu activation
learning.subtitle: Activate Hulu when you buy a Disney Bundle.
learning.summary: New bundle subscribers should activate Hulu before signing into the Hulu app.
learning.content:
Bundle plans and Hulu activation

Disney Bundle plans can include Hulu and ESPN+.

What to do first
After purchase, follow the email link to activate each service.

When to escalate
If Hulu asks you to start a new trial, contact support with your Disney+ email.

messages.content: How do I update my Disney+ payment method?

You can update your payment method while signed in on the web.

1. Go to disneyplus.com and sign in.
2. Open Account.
3. Choose Payment method, then Update.

If you subscribed through Apple, Google, Amazon, or a mobile carrier, you’ll need to change the payment method with that provider instead.
